content.title: AKUH signs agreement to provide laboratory services to South City Hospital

media.alt: AKUH signs agreement to provide laboratory services to South City Hospital

content.text: Aga Khan University Hospital (AKUH) will provide high quality on-site laboratory testing services to the recently refurbished South City Hospital. Mr Nurullah Merchant (seated left), Director General of University Administration signed the agreement on behalf of AKUH, while South City Hospital was represented by their Chairperson and renowned gynaecologist, Dr Sadia Rizvi (seated, centre).

Under the agreement, AKUH will provide state-of-the-art laboratory testing and diagnostic services to the 62-bed South City Hospital, in Clifton, which offers obstetrics and gynaecology, general surgery, cardiac surgery and orthopaedics services, as well as a cath laboratory. Consultants associated with the South City Hospital include Dr Sadia Rizvi, Dr Mumtaz Meher and Dr Sohail Thobani. This collaboration will make high quality laboratory services accessible to patients of South City Hospital as well as those residing in the south of Karachi. This initiative is in line with Aga Khan University's guiding principles of quality, accessibility, impact and relevance.

AKUH provides quality laboratory testing and phlebotomy services across Pakistan through a network of clinical laboratories, stat laboratories and specimen collection centres. The first teaching hospital in Pakistan to become ISO 9001: 2000 certified, AKUH ensures that all its services have consistency through a meticulous process of continual quality assurance.
